thread:
alex_sales: Heads-up: FinEdge wants a BYO-HSM POC before signing. They insist on customer-managed keys, dual-custody rotation, and a 24h rotation window. Also asked for an SOW that guarantees 99.9% availability for the HSM proxy. cc @jane_solutions @pradeep_crypto @elaine_legal

jane_solutions: Thanks — do we know expected QPS and average RTT to keyproxy? that affects batching/latency design.

alex_sales: They gave rough load: 120 rps sustained, 200 rps burst, median key op latency budget 10–15ms. Platform calls per request: sign + dek unwrap ~2 calls.

pradeep_crypto: Quick flags: 24h rotation + dual custody + FIPS L2/3 attestation narrows options. CloudHSM (AWS) is okay for many customers but FIPS L3 HSM appliances might require on-prem or partner HSMs. Also need remote attestation reports and HSM-backed key wrapping.

jane_solutions: For the proxy SLA — are they expecting our across-region HA or will they host the proxy in their VPC?

alex_sales: They prefer us to run the proxy in their VPC (BYO key material), but they want Redwood to guarantee proxy uptime in SOW. They also want an escalation matrix for key failover.

elaine_legal: This will trigger our enterprise review. Required: A) evidence of HSM attestation/chain-of-trust, B) contractual language around key custody and access, C) incident response timeline for key compromise. We'll need to see the customer's legal redlines on split custody.

pradeep_crypto: Implementation notes for solutions: - Recommend a small HSM-proxy fleet in the customer's VPC + a lightweight fallback to Redwood-managed CMKs for degraded ops. - Rotation: implement automatic key rolling with key version pinning for 24h window and a dry-run period. - Audit: exportable signed audit logs and attestation blobs.

jane_solutions: Can we show a sample config snippet and perf numbers? they'll want concrete numbers in the presales deck. e.g.:
```
# proxy config (example)
mode: byok
hsm_type: aws_cloudhsm
max_concurrency: 256
batching: auto
metrics_export: prometheus
```

alex_sales: Customer asks about cost delta vs Redwood CMK. They're OK with a premium but need a ballpark. Can ops give a rough delta (ops host + HSM fees + integration) so I can put in the estimate?

ops_oncall_bot: Automated note: previous BYO-HSM POCs averaged +$4k–$10k/mo depending on HSM size and network egress. (See internal presales playbook ref: /kb/byo-hsm-costs)

pradeep_crypto: + technical caveat: latencies can increase ~3–10ms per request depending on HSM proximity and network egress. We'll need to test with 200 rps bursts to validate tail latencies.

elaine_legal: Also confirm data residency and whether key material ever leaves customer VPC. If yes, we need explicit consent and technical mitigations.

jane_solutions: Action items: 1) @pradeep_crypto to draft a short architecture diagram + perf testing plan; 2) @ops_oncall_bot to provide cost ranges and typical SLA language; 3) @elaine_legal to prepare necessary contract clauses. Alex to sync with customer and request network/IP allowlist and expected maintenance windows.

alex_sales: I'll schedule a 30m call with FinEdge for tomorrow 10am PT and ask for their attestation samples and firewall ACLs. If we can get a test HSM endpoint we can run a 1h load run.

jane_solutions: One more thing — they want rotation demo during POC. Prepare a scripted rotation (non-disruptive) and a rollback plan.

pradeep_crypto: Agreed. I'll prep a small demo repo + runbook (rotate -> verify signatures -> rollback).

elaine_legal: I'll review standard SOW clauses and add a stub for HSM availability and indemnity. Expect follow-up in thread.

alex_sales: Perfect — will update after the call. :thumbsup:
